subject: Decision Making
title: Thaler and the Rise of Nudges
description: A quick win: understand Thaler and the Rise of Nudges.

hook.text: Richard Thaler noticed his students made irrational choices about money, food, and time. He studied why.

buildup.text: Thaler bridged psychology and economics. He showed that small changes in how choices are presented shift behavior.

discovery.text: A nudge changes behavior without banning options. Putting fruit at eye level makes people eat healthier by default.

twist.text: Thaler co-authored Nudge in 2008. Governments worldwide adopted nudge units to shape public behavior.

climax.text: Thaler won the Nobel in 2017. His work proved that context shapes choice more than willpower does.

punchline.text: Fruit at eye level changes diets. Small context shifts beat willpower.

quiz.question: What is a nudge?
options: A small change in context that influences behavior without removing options
